messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- [decision] The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. (since 2025-06-06; source standup/ember/2025-06-06)
- The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. (since 2025-06-06; source standup/ember/2025-06-06)
- [decision] The job scheduler's leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a follow-up decision from the INC-2026-009 review. (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. (since 2025-09-23; source handover/2025-09-23-scheduler)
  - earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. (held 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-05)
- [decision] As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune. (since 2025-06-25; source handover/2025-06-25-scheduler)
  - earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team. (held 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; source standup/ember/2025-01-20)
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then. (since 2025-09-23; source handover/2025-09-23-scheduler)
- As of 2026-05-22, the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump, per a heads-up from team Dune. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-3)
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. (since 2025-12-01; source standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2)
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team. (since 2025-09-23; source handover/2025-09-23-scheduler)
- The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches. (since 2025-02-07; source standup/ember/2025-02-07)
- [decision] Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17. (since 2025-03-17; source standup/boreal/2025-03-17)
  - earlier: [decision] Marcus takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Lena on 2025-02-12. (held 2025-02-12 to 2025-03-17; source standup/boreal/2025-02-12)
  - earlier: [decision] Lena takes the first pager rotation for the Boreal team. (held 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; source standup/boreal/2025-01-09-4)
- [constraint] As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. (since 2025-08-19; source standup/dune/2025-08-19)
  - earlier: [constraint] Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. (held 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; source standup/ember/2025-02-06)
- The job scheduler is not the Boreal team's service, so the Boreal team flagged it. (since 2025-12-01; source standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2)
- [decision] As of 2025-11-06, Marcus has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena. (since 2025-11-06; source standup/boreal/2025-11-06)
  - earlier: [decision] As of 2025-09-23, for anything Boreal-related, page Lena this cycle, not Marcus. (held 2025-09-23 to 2025-11-06; source standup/boreal/2025-09-23)
- [decision] As of 2025-08-15, Marcus has the Boreal team pager this cycle, taking over from Lena. (since 2025-08-15; source standup/boreal/2025-08-15)
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team. (since 2025-10-13; source handover/2025-10-13-ledger)
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team. (since 2025-10-13; source handover/2025-10-13-ledger)
- Team Dune observed that the event-bus' request volume halved after the client rollout. (since 2025-12-29; source standup/dune/2025-12-29)
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2)
